Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on what B2Health needs to choose a deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem).

Call recap (high level):
- Primary requirement: HIPAA-covered PHI processing; customer must have an executed BAA.
- Security asks: current priority is SOC 2 Type II report, network architecture diagram for any peering/VPC options, and evidence of access controls/audit logs retention.
- Operational preference: team leans toward Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, but will consider Hosted if the BAA + encryption/network isolation (Private VPC peering or transit) meets security constraints.

What I need from you to finalize recommendation:
1) Confirm who is the security contact at B2Health to receive SOC2 artifacts (name + email).
2) Confirm procurement timeline (approx. target date to have contract/BAA executed).
3) Any hard constraints on data residency or on-prem processing (e.g., must be in a specific cloud region or air-gapped).

Attached: redwood_baa_template.pdf — feel free to share with your legal/procurement team; we can accept edits and execute via DocuSign.

Proposed Redwood next steps once we get the items above:
- Share SOC 2 summary and SOC auditor contact (we sent SOC2 Type II link in follow-up).
- Provide a short VPC peering playbook and network diagram tailored to your cloud provider (we’ll draft).
- If Dedicated is preferred, we’ll outline capacity sizing and committed term options for pricing.

Would you be available for a 30-minute follow-up on Monday to walk security/procurement through the evidence pack?

Thanks —
Rishi

Hi Rishi —

Appreciate the summary. Quick answers:
- Security contact: Michael Smith (michael.smith@b2health.com) — he handles vendor assessments and will need the SOC2 Type II report and the network diagram.
- Procurement timeline: target to have contract/BAA signed by end of July (we have a July 31 internal deadline).
- Residency: US-only is preferred; primary workloads in us-west-2. No on-prem requirement today, but some teams may ask later.

We are inclined toward Dedicated capacity for predictable latency, but we need to see the SOC2 report and a network diagram that shows how VPC peering or private connectivity would be implemented. If Hosted includes a contractual BAA and supports private network connectivity (VPC peering / PrivateLink), we may evaluate it as a cost-saving option.

Next steps on our side:
- I’ll route the BAA to procurement and legal for an initial review (procurement@b2health.com).
- Michael will review the SOC2 and reach back with any gaps — he may ask for evidence of logging/audit retention and key management (KMS/HSM).

Can we do 30 minutes next Tuesday (July 3) at 10:00am PT? Michael will join.

Thanks,
